outOfContextError.description: This chat is reaching the AI's memory limit, like a whiteboard filling up. We can expand the memory window (called context size) so it remembers more, but it may use more of your computer's memory. We can also truncate the input, which means it will forget some of the chat history to make room for new messages.

ctx_len.title: Context Size
ctx_len.description: Size of the prompt context. Leave empty to auto-fit when --fit is on.

ngl.title: GPU Layers
ngl.description: Number of model layers to offload to the GPU (-1 for all layers, 0 for CPU only).

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature for sampling (higher = more random). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Top-K sampling (0 = disabled). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Top-P sampling (1.0 = disabled). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

min_p.title: Min P
min_p.description: Min-P sampling (0.0 = disabled). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

repeat_last_n.title: Repeat Last N
repeat_last_n.description: Number of tokens to consider for repeat penalty (0 = disabled, -1 = ctx_size). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

repeat_penalty.title: Repeat Penalty
repeat_penalty.description: Penalize repeating token sequences (1.0 = disabled). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Repeat alpha presence penalty (0.0 = disabled). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Repeat alpha frequency penalty (0.0 = disabled). This is the default setting on load and can be overridden by the assistant settings.

chat_template.title: Custom Jinja Chat template
chat_template.description: Custom Jinja chat_template to be used for the model

cpu_moe.title: Keep all Experts in CPU
cpu_moe.description: Keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU (if GPU is used).

n_cpu_moe.title: Number of MoE weights in the CPU
n_cpu_moe.description: Keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU (if GPU is used)

override_tensor_buffer_t.title: Override Tensor Buffer Type
override_tensor_buffer_t.description: Override the tensor buffer type for the model

no_kv_offload.title: Disable KV Offload
no_kv_offload.description: Disable KV cache offload to GPU (if GPU is used).

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Logical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Use reasoning/thinking in the chat. 'auto' detects from the chat template.

max_context_tokens.title: Max Context Tokens
max_context_tokens.description: Total token budget (input + output). Older messages are trimmed/compacted to stay within this. 0 disables trimming.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may generate in one reply. Sent as max_tokens to OpenAI-compatible APIs.

auto_compact.title: Auto Compact
auto_compact.description: When context limit is reached, summarize older messages instead of dropping them. Requires Max Context Tokens to be set.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold. Higher values allow more diverse word choices.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Sample from the top K most likely tokens. 0 = disabled.

min_p.title: Min P
min_p.description: Minimum relative probability for a token to be considered.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Reduces word repetition based on prior frequency.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Encourages the model to introduce new topics.

repeat_penalty.title: Repeat Penalty
repeat_penalty.description: llama.cpp-style multiplicative penalty for repeated tokens. 1.0 = disabled.

mirostat.title: Mirostat
mirostat.effectHint: When enabled, overrides Top K / Top P / Min P.

json_schema.title: JSON Schema
json_schema.description: JSON schema constraining the output to valid JSON.

top_n_sigma.title: Top N Sigma
top_n_sigma.description: Filter by standard deviations above the max logit. -1 = off.

dynatemp_range.title: Dynamic Temperature Range
dynatemp_range.description: Effective temperature is sampled in [temperature - range, temperature + range]. 0 = off.

dynatemp_exp.title: Dynamic Temperature Exponent
dynatemp_exp.description: Shapes the temperature distribution within the range.

xtc_probability.title: XTC Probability
xtc_probability.description: Probability of activating the Exclude-Top-Choices sampler.

xtc_threshold.title: XTC Threshold
xtc_threshold.description: Minimum token probability to be eligible for XTC exclusion.

dry_allowed_length.title: DRY Allowed Length
dry_allowed_length.description: Minimum repeated-sequence length before DRY engages.

dry_penalty_last_n.title: DRY Penalty Window
dry_penalty_last_n.description: Recent-token window DRY scans. -1 = full context, 0 = off.

repeat_last_n.title: Repeat Last N
repeat_last_n.description: Number of recent tokens considered for the repeat penalty. -1 = full context, 0 = disabled.

samplers.title: Sampler Order
samplers.description: Order in which samplers are applied, comma-separated (e.g. "top_k,typ_p,top_p,min_p,xtc,temperature"). Empty = server default order.

backend_sampling.title: Backend Sampling
backend_sampling.description: Use the model backend's own sampler instead of llama.cpp's.

thinking_budget_tokens.title: Thinking Budget
thinking_budget_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may spend on reasoning before being forced to answer. -1 = unlimited.

mirostat.title: Mirostat
mirostat.description: Adaptive perplexity-targeting sampler. Overrides Top K / Top P / Min P.

dry.title: DRY
dry.description: Don't-Repeat-Yourself penalty for long repeated sequences.

xtc.title: XTC
xtc.description: Exclude-Top-Choices sampler — probabilistically removes high-prob tokens.

dynatemp.title: Dynamic Temperature
dynatemp.description: Sample the effective temperature from a range around the base.
